paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization (WindFLO): An Advanced Framework for Fast Wind Farm Analysis and Optimization

supplied: WindFLO C++ and Fortran source with six wake and four merging models
Vestas V90-3MW Cp data, 489-point AWEC terrain and example inputs
Cal et al. wind-tunnel inputs in tag v1.0.0
generic GA and PSO examples and stored example outputs

source_oracle.details: The hard-coded g++-10/gfortran-10 Makefile and Linux shared-link recipe do not build unchanged on the current host. A temporary unmodified-source static build with matching g++-13/gfortran-13 reproduced the stored Example2 power, efficiency, AEP, cost and land metrics exactly.

soho_supplement.title: Many-Objective Hybrid Optimization Under Uncertainty With Applications
soho_supplement.use: supplies constitutive NSGA-III, NSDE-R and MOEA-DD operators and published parameters; the target paper supplies their three-kernel single-objective relay

paper_native_protocol.validation: Tables 2 and 3: two probe locations by six wake models by four merge schemes
paper_native_protocol.optimization: Table 4: reference, Case 1 and Case 2 under Frandsen and BP wakes
paper_native_protocol.site: 2 km by 2 km scaled AWEC terrain

missing_information: target SOHO source and target optimization random states, traces and four optimized layouts
numeric 2019 cli-MATE direction-speed table and original machine-readable wind observations
target SOHO population, generation budget, stagnation window and independent repeat count
complete executable RBF setup and the exact optimization rotor-integration sample sequence
conflicts_and_completions: The paper specifies local RBF terrain interpolation while public Example4 overrides terrain interpolation to IDW; paper-local-RBF is primary and source-IDW is an executable conflict profile.
The public disk sampler uses radius R times u, which is not uniform in disk area; production uses R times square-root(u), and source-uniform-radius remains an executable profile.
The public DWM implementation repeatedly scales the accumulated prior deficit by overlap; production uses the intended maximum weighted deficit and records the source expression.
The paper prints 26280 MWh as all-turbine rated annual energy although 25 times 3 MW times 8760 h is 657000 MWh and Table 4 is consistent with the farm-scale denominator; production uses 657000 MWh.
The public terrain arc approximation advances only the rotated x coordinate; production uses the three-dimensional separation induced by interpolated upstream and downstream elevations.

The public Larsen expression yields negative deficits for some validation points and reproduces the unstable published validation behavior; it remains available only for the validation matrix while production optimization uses the paper-selected Frandsen and BP models.
Digitize Figure 10(c) into sixteen direction totals and seven conditional speed-bin weights, normalize their Cartesian product and identify it as a declared wind reconstruction.
Use a 65 by 65 terrain grid built from the exact 489 public points; paper-local-RBF uses sixteen local neighbors and source-IDW uses twenty-four.
Use SOHO population 100, 200 generations and a 20-generation stagnation window; no completion is calibrated to Table 4.

Use dissertation parameters: NSGA-III and MOEA-DD simulated-binary crossover probability 1, mutation probability one over dimension, crossover index 30 and mutation index 20; MOEA-DD neighborhood 20, delta 0.9 and theta 5; NSDE-R F 0.5 and Cr 0.7.
Use 25 platform seeds because the paper gives no independent repeat count.

hpc.prior_parallel_boundary: The target paper explicitly declares master-slave parallel optimization and the public PSO accepts an external parallel-evaluation function. No target SOHO parallel source, schedule, deterministic identity evidence, physical-work receipt or scaling data are public; first-parallelization is outside the claim boundary.
strategy: one persistent all-core executor per complete run
parallel fixed-index generation of complete offspring from an immutable parent population
parallel complete-layout evaluation across the population
parallel independent execution of the 48 wind-tunnel validation roles
immutable precomputed terrain grids, direction-speed scenarios and turbine curves
counter-keyed schedule-independent random events and deterministic ordered survivor commits
hpc.dominant_complexity: four optimization roles times population times generations times 112 wind states times 25-squared ordered wake interactions, with rotor quadrature for BP interactions
hpc.required_invariant: one-worker and all-worker validation, layouts, kernel histories, physical-work counts and scientific hash identity

claim_boundary: Source-backed flexible academic reconstruction of WindFLO, the target three-kernel SOHO relay, the two AWEC optimization cases and all 54 native Tables 2-4 roles; not the unavailable author SOHO implementation, original cli-MATE table, random states, layouts, numerical replay of Table 4 or first parallelization.
